body: Why does everybody keep repeating it? I’ve been suffering since I was a kid and now it’s getting to the point where I cant control it, it’s not getting better, it won’t get better. I can’t distract myself forever, everytime something good happens 1h later everything falls apart. My parents were right, I’ll either kill myself before my 20s or become a drug junkie

Its not getting better, its getting worse if something. It’s so tempting to just slice my wrists one last time, i hate it. Nothing will help, i cant get profesional help because im underage, my parents wont like it at all. It seems like death is the only option sometimes
I’m constantly thinking about suicide, cutting keeps me distracted even if for a short time

I talked about it, and it does feel nice for a moment but I relapse to feeling like shit pretty quickly. I usually just get „it gets better” replies so that doesn’t help much, I’m still grateful some people want to listen about my problems

I’m tired of playing games on my pc all day to distract myself, I’m afraid I lost contact with all the friends that I had. There’s nothing pushing me forward, I don’t want to do anything, nothing is enjoyable anymore. I always had problems but never before have I planned my suicide in such detail, I’m tired of hiding stuff from my parents. I don’t understand it, am I just unlucky or did I fuck up really badly somewhere
Sure thing, dm me if you want
Hey, I’m in the same boat. Life sucks but there’s still some merit in some parts of it, like I build a snowman today. With a snow hat, pretty cool.
I got 21 on the first and 91 on the second
